decisions.reason: Offshore vessel management lies very close to the firm's core ship management knowledge and is a strategic flagship tied to its offshore energy and renewables direction, so the firm can interpret results and refine it.

Crew and corporate travel management builds directly on the firm's crewing operations and established customer base, which lets it absorb feedback, though as an ancillary service it is somewhat more exposed to restructuring after the pandemic travel disruption.

The online vessel information portal is a flagship digital extension of the firm's core management service, and the firm's operational data and cooperation with research institutions help it learn and improve the product.

The mobile performance app builds on established vessel operations knowledge, but the firm has limited in-house software R&D, which makes it more likely than the others to be merged into the portal or dropped, though keeping it remains more likely.
